issue.title: Restore agents-sync hood publication by slimming the owner manifest
issue.description: New agent hoods publish to the sase--agents sidecar again on athena (including the backfilled sase-11l hood and its sase-11l.2 run page), single-hood publishes finish well inside the drain timeout, and the owner manifest format no longer has an imminent byte or hood-count ceiling.

issue.title: Slim owner manifest, raise manifest caps, scope validation
issue.description: slim-manifest-fix: make per-hood manifest `files` optional on read and omitted on write behind a new slim_agents_manifest sunset flag, add dedicated (larger) manifest byte and hood-count read caps plus a pre-write size guard, scope run-file re-hashing to the hoods being written, and lock old-reader lenient-skip compatibility in with tests.

issue.title: Recover the athena outbox and backfill unpublished hoods
issue.description: athena-recovery-backfill: with the fixed sase installed on athena, drop retired and retry quarantined publication outbox items, repair the owner manifest's missing on-disk hoods, run a full reconcile sync, and verify the sase-11l.2 agent page is live on GitHub and the manifest shrank.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: flaky test tests/ace/tui/test_bead_close_modal.py::test_force_selects_non_done_resolution_and_returns_close_contract - failed with textual.pilot.WaitForScreenTimeout during a full `just check` run (42148 passed, 1 failed) but passed in isolation and on a full retry of test-scoped (42149 passed, 0 failed). Unrelated to sase-11o.1 (agents_sync/feature_flags only); looks like a Textual pilot timing flake under parallel load.

Implemented slim-manifest-fix per plan phase 1: made per-hood manifest files optional on read (v2_manifest_io.decode_owner_manifest) and omitted on write behind new sunset flag slim_agents_manifest (bead sase-11p, registry entry added + schema synced via tools/sync_feature_flags_schema); added dedicated MAX_MANIFEST_JSON_BYTES (16MiB)/MAX_MANIFEST_HOODS (16384) read caps in v2_validation.py used only by manifest reads; load_validated_publication now skips the files cross-check when an entry's files is None and scopes verify_run_files to override_snapshots keys (the hoods actually being published) instead of every hood of every owner; added a pre-write check_manifest_write_size guard called from plan_hoods, repair_owner_hood_digests, and _repair_owner_manifest before apply_payload_atomic; refreshed the stale publication_repair.py module docstring. Verified: tools/check_feature_flags (full, incl. bead-status rules) and tools/sync_feature_flags_schema both clean; new tests cover fat/slim decode round-trip, a frozen old-reader lenient-skip lock-in test, the new caps, the write guard, scoped verification (drift in an unpublished hood no longer blocks an unrelated publish; drift in the published hood's own carried-forward run still blocks it), and flag ON/OFF for the writer and both repair paths (tests/agents_sync/test_v2_io.py, test_publication.py, test_publication_repair.py). Ran full `just check`: all lint gates green (ruff, mypy, symvision, toobig, feature flags, etc.); the diff-scoped test lane (42148 tests, broad due to feature_flags/registry.py + v2_validation.py being widely imported) had exactly one failure, tests/ace/tui/test_bead_close_modal.py::test_force_selects_non_done_resolution_and_returns_close_contract, a Textual pilot WaitForScreenTimeout unrelated to this change; confirmed as flaky by passing in isolation and on a full test-scoped retry (42149 passed, 0 failed). No leftover --epic-symbol entries (sase bead epic-symbols sase-11o.1 reported none).

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: full agent-hood reconcile publish hard-fails at current scale (~2091 hoods, ~311.5 MB on-disk agents payload) with AgentsSyncFormatError "publication payload exceeds the byte limit" from apply_payload_atomic (src/sase/agents_sync/v2_io.py:79-85), because MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES is a fixed 128 MiB (v2_validation.py:29) and reconcile_agent_hoods -> plan_hoods (publication_planning.py:78-109) unconditionally rebuilds and includes full payload bytes (snapshot + rendered pages) for EVERY eligible hood in one atomic commit -- including unchanged hoods -- with zero batching/chunking anywhere in that path. This is distinct from and NOT fixed by the slim_agents_manifest owner-manifest fix (sase-11o.1): that fixed the per-hood manifest-entry byte cost, but plan_hoods still assembles one giant all-hoods payload dict every full reconcile. Impact: (1) sase-11l cannot be backfilled -- its hood directory does not exist on disk in the sase--agents sidecar or in the owner manifest at all, and only a full reconcile creates a brand-new hood dir for a dormant hood with no actively-committing agent, so sase-11l.2 page publication stays blocked; (2) bare `sase agent sync` (no flags) fails identically for this owner/project going forward, since _integrate_export_pass (git_sync.py:322-344) calls reconcile_agent_hoods unconditionally on every normal sync pass, not gated behind --drop-retired/--retry-quarantined; (3) legacy fat manifest entries only convert to the new slim format when their own hood is individually republished, so the manifest stays well over its old 4 MiB shape until every hood gets touched one at a time. Needs a follow-up phase to add batching/chunking to plan_hoods/reconcile_agent_hoods (publish N hoods per commit) or otherwise bound per-commit payload size, then rerun `sase agent sync --repair-manifest` (already run, safe) + a full reconcile to backfill sase-11l.

Progress before hitting the blocker above: (1) updated athena installed sase via `sase update` to pick up phase-1 (slim_agents_manifest confirmed registered + ON in flag registry); (2) `sase agent sync --drop-retired -p sase` cleared all 71 terminal outbox items (verified terminal count 71->0 in agents-publication-outbox.json); (3) `sase agent sync --retry-quarantined -p sase` cleared quarantine on all outbox items (646->0 quarantined), giving them a fresh attempt budget for the bounded per-hood commit-triggered drain path; (4) `sase agent sync --repair-manifest -p sase` succeeded (exit 0, "synchronized"), recovering 47 previously-unreferenced on-disk hoods into the owner manifest, each written in the new slim shape (no `files` key) confirming the phase-1 writer works correctly in production; manifest hood count now matches on-disk hood-directory count (2091). Not yet achieved: full reconcile sync (blocked, see PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP note), sase-11l backfill (blocked on the same), manifest byte-size shrink (legacy fat entries only slim down as their own hood republishes), and clean verification that no outbox items are failing (current failures are lock contention "agents sync lock is busy" from heavy concurrent host activity, a separate pre-existing condition, not a manifest-byte error). Leaving this bead in_progress rather than closing since phase success criteria are unmet.
